description: This header file declares functions and types for managing UCI (Unified Configuration Interface) sections and options within the beerocks::bpl namespace, including functions for checking existence, finding, adding, setting, getting, deleting sections, and committing changes.

methods.name: uci_section_exists
methods.description: Checks if a section exists in the configuration database.

methods.name: uci_find_section_by_option
methods.description: Finds a section with a specific type and containing an option with a given value.

methods.name: uci_add_section
methods.description: Adds a new named section to the configuration.

methods.name: uci_set_section
methods.description: Sets or updates options within a section, adding or removing options as needed.

methods.name: uci_get_section
methods.description: Retrieves all options within a section.

methods.name: uci_get_section_type
methods.description: Gets the type of a section by its name.

methods.name: uci_get_option
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific option within a section.

methods.name: uci_delete_section
methods.description: Deletes a section from the configuration.

methods.name: uci_get_all_sections
methods.description: Retrieves all sections of a specific type.

methods.name: uci_commit_changes
methods.description: Commits pending changes to the configuration.
